subject: Cinderlane technical immersion: scope, dates, and pre-reqs
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Torres <emily.torres@cinderlane.com>, Mike Han <mike.han@cinderlane.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cinderlane technical immersion: scope, dates, and pre-reqs

Hi Emily / Mike,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — excited at the prospect of partnering on the SI program for Cinderlane's new GenAI offering. Per our call, we think a focused two-day technical immersion (engineering + solutions architects) is the right first step to get your delivery teams comfortable with Redwood's Dedicated and Private deployment patterns.

Proposed high-level objectives:
- Walk through Redwood serving runtime and model routing patterns relevant to your use cases
- Hands-on labs: prompt + eval harness, prefix/KV cache patterns, and autoscaling tuning
- Integration checkpoints: SSO, data retention, and observability hooks (tracing + cost breakdown)

Proposed dates: Aug 15–16 (your timezone) — flexible if you prefer the following week.

Pre-reqs we need from Cinderlane:
- A short completed security checklist (SSO, data handling, encryption) — I can accept a doc or answers inline
- List of 4 engineers who will join the hands-on lab and their laptop/GPU access constraints

I've attached a draft agenda and a short runbook link here for quick review: https://drive.google.com/redwood/cinderlane-immersion-agenda

Would you prefer our workshop on your VPC (private) or Redwood-hosted sandbox? We can support either — private requires a brief network/credential handoff before the session.

Next steps: if Aug 15–16 works, we'll circulate a detailed prep checklist and a SOW draft for review.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Partner Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_SI_Immersion_Agenda.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Emily Torres <emily.torres@cinderlane.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Han <mike.han@cinderlane.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jul 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cinderlane technical immersion: scope, dates, and pre-reqs

Jasmine,

Thanks — Aug 15–16 looks promising. A few quick items from our side before we lock dates: 

1) Security questionnaire: can you provide an example or can we send our standard vendor checklist? I've attached our security checklist template so your compliance team can confirm.
2) SSO / IdP: we run Okta for staff. We need to confirm SSO flow for the sandbox and any short-lived token requirements for the labs.
3) Cost/consumption guardrails: who will be a Redwood contact for per-session cost monitoring? We want to avoid surprises during hands-on labs.

We can do Aug 15–16 afternoons PT (1300–1700 PT) — that will fit our delivery team's calendars. If you need full-day sessions, we can expand to the 17th.

Attaching: Cinderlane_Security_Checklist.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Emily Torres
Head of Solutions Delivery
Cinderlane Consulting
[Attachment: Cinderlane_Security_Checklist.docx]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Torres <emily.torres@cinderlane.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jul 2028 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cinderlane technical immersion: scope, dates, and pre-reqs

Hi Emily — great to meet you (virtually). Jasmine looped me in to coordinate logistics and the SOW. Quick answers below and attachment list.

Security questionnaire:
- We reviewed your checklist — attached are short answers to each section (see Redwood_Security_Responses.pdf inline in the agenda package). If any question needs a longer artifact (SOC2 report, encryption whitepaper), we can route that through our security team.

SSO / IdP:
- We support Okta SAML with short-lived service tokens for lab sandboxes. For Private/VPC deployments we recommend configuring an SP-initiated flow; Karthik can run a 30-min network/SSO checklist call with your infra lead prior to the immersion.

Cost guardrail contact:
- Karthik Iyer will be the session-level operations lead and point-of-contact for consumption/cost and autoscaling thresholds during labs (karthik.iyer@redwood.ai).

Draft SOW & agenda: attached (Redwood_SOW_Draft_v0.1.pdf) — it includes the two-day agenda, deliverables (runbook, eval prompt set, post-session recorded lab), and optional follow-up enablement hours.

Proposed schedule (Aug 15–16, PT):
- Day 1 (1300–1700 PT): platform deep-dive, hands-on prompt/eval labs, KV/prefix caching exercises
- Day 2 (1300–1700 PT): integration labs (SSO, network pre-reqs), observability walkthrough, and joint runbook creation

Pre-session tasks for Cinderlane by Aug 10:
- Completed security checklist (you already sent this — thanks)
- List of attendees + Okta admin contact for the IdP run-through
- Any sample prompts/expected latency SLAs you want us to test

Attachments included in this message package: Redwood_SI_Immersion_Agenda.pdf, Redwood_SOW_Draft_v0.1.pdf

If that works, Jasmine will send a calendar invite and Karthik will propose a 30-min pre-flight call.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Partner Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_SOW_Draft_v0.1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Emily Torres <emily.torres@cinderlane.com>

Cc: Mike Han <mike.han@cinderlane.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cinderlane technical immersion: scope, dates, and pre-reqs

Thanks all — that looks good. We will: 
- Confirm the four engineers and Okta admin by Friday (Aug 2)
- Issue a PO referencing the SOW (PO attached) — expect internal approvals by next Tuesday
- Schedule the Okta checklist call for Aug 8 (Mike will be the admin on that call)

A couple of clarifications: 
- For the labs we prefer Redwood-hosted sandbox with IdP-enabled short-lived tokens (no private VPC for the first session).
- Please flag any lab prep that requires us to open inbound IP ranges or share temporary credentials.

Attaching: Cinderlane_PO_4521.pdf
